exposure: Psoriatic arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, ankylosing spondylitis, uveitis, Behcet's disease, panuveitis
cohort: 30 pregnant women with inflammatory arthropathies treated with adalimumab, referred to Golestan Hospital in Ahvaz (Iran) from 2014 to 2017.
finding: The study found no significant differences in cesarean section and neonatal outcomes based on the type of disease, but there were differences in delivery outcomes.
